about.title: Full Stack Developer with experience in
about.p1: My name is <1>Christie Cardoso</1> and I am a <1>Full Stack</1> developer with about 2 years of experience. I mainly work with web systems, both front-end and back-end, always trying to keep the code simple and well-organized.
about.p2: I completed my postgraduate degree in <1>Distributed Software Architecture at PUC Minas</1> (2025). Today I work at MyPetOne, working on internal systems, process automation, and integrations with ERPs and marketplaces.
about.p3: On the front-end, I use React and Next.js a lot. On the back-end, Node.js and PostgreSQL. I usually use Docker and Prisma daily to maintain standards and facilitate maintenance.

skills.title: My Skills
skills.subtitle: Technologies and tools I use in my daily life

exp1.description: I participate in the development and improvement of scalable internal systems, focusing on the automation of important flows and integration via REST APIs with major Marketplaces. On the front-end, I work with React and Next.js using Tailwind CSS to create agile and high-performance interfaces. I also collaborate on environmental standardization with Docker and data architecture with PostgreSQL/MongoDB using Prisma ORM, always seeking to improve efficiency and minimize operational errors.

exp2.description: I developed customized solutions for WordPress sites using PHP and JavaScript. My focus was on performance optimization (Web Vitals) and improving UI/UX to offer a smoother user experience. I was also responsible for managing hosting environments via cPanel, including theme configuration, plugins, and preventive maintenance to ensure the proper functioning and high availability of the sites.

exp3.description: I provided technical support for end users and assisted in the administration of network infrastructure. I implemented backup and data recovery routines to ensure information integrity and process continuity. I was also involved in managing technical tickets and configuring machines in hybrid environments (Windows/Linux), always seeking to resolve problems efficiently.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: I am available for freelance projects that allow me to apply and expand my technical skills, always seeking new challenges to grow as a developer.
